data.title: 艾雅法拉 · 暖沙滩涂上的微温贝壳收集
data.action: 小心翼翼地捧着盛满彩色小贝壳与光滑海玻璃的编织小篮子，微侧过头贴近聆听海浪的大声呢喃
data.location: 阳光温热平缓的火山砂细软浅海沙滩
data.lighting: 日光由水面反射到篮沿和珊瑚粉荷叶边，潮沟与黑砂保留柔和明暗
data.mood: 温柔纤弱、纯真依赖与心满意足的宁静幸福
data.description: 午后的沙滩被太阳晒得温热松软。艾雅法拉把针织小斗篷拢在肩上，小心地护着篮子里五颜六色的贝壳与海玻璃。因为听觉不便，她微微倾过身躯，努力辨识着海浪击打沙岸的震动。看见你走近，她脸上绽放出毫无保留的安心笑靥，轻声唤道——「前辈……！快看，这些贝壳被地热温泉冲刷过，摸起来暖暖的。这一颗最圆最光滑的海玻璃，我想做成挂坠……送给前辈。」
data.promptProse: Eyjafjalla pauses where the shallow tide has drawn thin channels in the dark volcanic sand. Her coral-peach swimsuit has cream ruffles beneath a loosely crocheted capelet. She cradles a small wicker basket with both hands, tilting her head toward the breaking waves. Sunlight catches the ridges of pale scallop shells and a few smooth pieces of sea glass in the basket. From the side, follow the diagonal of the beach behind her through the shallow channels to a strip of bright water.
data.animaCaption: Pausing along the dark volcanic sand in her coral-pink ruffled bikini and loose cream crochet capelet, she cradles a wicker basket of seashells and sea glass and tilts her head toward the gentle waves with a warm smile.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a coral-pink two-piece ruffled bikini with side-tie strings, baring her shoulders and midriff under a loose cream crochet beach capelet.
